firstNightReminder: Wake both twins. Allow eye contact. Show the good twin's character token to the Evil Twin & vice versa.

en.name: Evil Twin
en.ability: You & an opposing player know each other. If the good player is executed, evil wins. Good can't win if you both live.
en.flavor: I'm not Sara! I'm Clara! SHE is Sara! Sara is the evil one! Not me!

zh.name: 镜像双子
zh.ability: 你与一名对立阵营的玩家互相知道对方是什么角色。如果其中善良玩家被处决，邪恶阵营获胜。如果你们都存活，善良阵营无法获胜。
